description: A Python script that processes a JSON input describing a CRLSet and generates a binary CRLSet file, extracting and encoding certificate data such as SPKI hashes, subject hashes, and serial numbers.

classes.name: ASN1Iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for parsing ASN.1 DER-encoded data structures

methods.name: _pem_cert_to_binary
methods.description: Decodes the first PEM-encoded certificate in a file into binary data

methods.name: _parse_asn1_element
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded ASN.1 element into its components

methods.name: ASN1Iterator.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the ASN1Iterator with contents and begins processing

methods.name: ASN1Iterator.step_into
methods.description: Processes the inner contents of the next ASN.1 element

methods.name: ASN1Iterator.tag
methods.description: Returns the ASN.1 tag of the current element

methods.name: ASN1Iterator.contents
methods.description: Returns the raw data of the current ASN.1 element

methods.name: ASN1Iterator.encoded_value
methods.description: Returns the encoded value of the current ASN.1 element

methods.name: _der_cert_to_spki
methods.description: Extracts the subjectPublicKeyInfo from a DER-encoded certificate

methods.name: der_cert_to_spki_hash
methods.description: Returns SHA-256 hash of the subjectPublicKeyInfo of a DER-encoded certificate

methods.name: pem_cert_file_to_spki_hash
methods.description: Returns SHA-256 hash of the subjectPublicKeyInfo from a PEM certificate file

methods.name: der_cert_to_subject_hash
methods.description: Returns SHA-256 hash of the subject of a DER-encoded certificate

methods.name: pem_cert_file_to_subject_hash
methods.description: Returns SHA-256 hash of the subject from a PEM certificate file

methods.name: der_cert_to_serial
methods.description: Extracts the serial number from a DER-encoded certificate

methods.name: pem_cert_file_to_serial
methods.description: Returns DER-encoded serial number from a PEM certificate file

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that reads JSON input, processes certificate data, and writes a CRLSet binary output
